messages:
emma_sales: Heads-up: SolarisBank procurement will only accept PO line items tagged to their cost centers (CC-SYS / CC-RISK). Their PO will reference "Solaris-Redwood-Subscription" instead of our marketplace sku. They need the commit discount effective immediately for a 2-week POC.
oliver_dealdesk: Thanks. If the PO lacks our offer_id+sku, marketplace auto-commit detection will likely fail. Two practical choices: A) Private Offer with mapped SKUs (clean, 48-72h), B) accept PO and do manual attribution + retro credit if marketplace metering misses.
paula_finance: Finance prefers Private Offer for auditability. If timeline requires, we can approve a one-off manual attribution but require: signed buyer acknowledgement, credit cap, GL codes, and 45-day claim window. Accounting will require the signed ack before processing credits.
kevin_se: Quick technical note: If procurement can include our offer id in the PO line description (e.g. "offer_aws_sol_03"), AWS usually preserves that and metering will still map. Azure/GCP behavior varies. Worth asking procurement to drop it in description.
emma_sales: I asked them. They say their template is locked but they can include text in the line description. They can add the offer id there. Buyer still wants written guarantee the commit will be honored.
marketplace-bot: FYI: Private Offer creation locks current ratecard and requires partner config. ETA 48-72h once deal desk approves. See: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/offer-flow (internal).
oliver_dealdesk: Draft fallback language for manual attribution: "Redwood will accept the PO referencing the customer's internal SKU label and will manually attribute usage to the agreed marketplace SKU for the period Sep 2026. If marketplace metering does not map charges, Redwood will issue a one-time credit up to $18,000 within 45 days following invoice, subject to receipt of a signed buyer acknowledgement and right to audit usage for verification." Sending to legal + finance.
paula_finance: GL codes: REV_MARKET_09, CREDIT_RETRO_09. Finance ok with $18k cap for this POC. Accounting insists on signed ack prior to issuing any credit.
kevin_se: Minimal mapping snippet for accounting ticket to paste into the billing request:
```
offer_id: offer_aws_sol_03
marketplace_sku: redwood.marketplace.solaris.v1
customer_label: "Solaris-Redwood-Subscription"
line_description: "offer_aws_sol_03 | Solaris-Redwood-Subscription"
notes: manual attribution fallback for Sep 2026 POC
```
oliver_dealdesk: Circulating to legal now. If legal approves one-time exception we accept PO and log manual attribution. If legal declines, we escalate to Private Offer.
legal-bot: Legal review: acceptable with edits — require buyer ack to explicitly permit Redwood to request invoice detail for verification, keep 45-day window, include credit cap. Updated clause posted.
emma_sales: Buyer signed the acknowledgement and added the offer id to the PO line description as requested. Uploading PO + ack to SFDC now. They want to start POC tomorrow.
oliver_dealdesk: Deal desk approves one-time manual attribution with the approved language. Action items: 1) emma_sales attach PO + ack in SFDC (done), 2) paula_finance open accounting ticket with GL codes and cap, 3) kevin_se add mapping to billing notes and monitor invoice feed.
paula_finance: Accounting ticket created. Will monitor first invoice and hold credits until signed ack verified.
kevin_se: Will watch marketplace invoice for the offer id in line description and report back within 48h. If the description is preserved we likely don't need the retro workflow.
emma_sales: Thanks team 44f POC scheduled to start tomorrow. Ping here if invoice looks off.
